description: This file is a shell script used for diagnosing or configuring device status LEDs on specific hardware platforms within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to determine and set the state of LEDs based on the board type and system state.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the appropriate status LED based on the board type.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the input argument, such as preinit, failsafe, or done.
